workflow: There are many ways to conserve energy and reduce your energy consumption.  These include using energy-saving appliances and taking steps to make your home more energy-efficient, such as by installing insulation and weatherstripping, unplugging electronics when not in use, replacing old windows and doors, and using energy-efficient lighting.
